name: assistant-ui
summary: assistant-ui is an open-source TypeScript library of composable chat primitives (threads, composers, messages, branching, attachments) with runtimes that connect them to different agent backends. It also renders tool UIs, generative UI and MCP Apps, and offers an optional hosted Assistant Cloud for thread persistence.
facts: AI SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, AG-UI, A2A and custom
Tool UI, generative UI, MCP Apps
goodFor: Production chat UIs without building primitives from scratch
Swapping agent backends behind one UI
watchOut: Hosted persistence is a separate paid service
